title: Diameter: Remove dead code for pre Internet Draft 16 protocol
description:
There's some code intended to decode an older Internet Draft version
of Diameter, before December 2002. It's supposed to be set by an
obsolete enum preference, but due to a misunderstanding, it's
been dead code for the last 15 years. No one has complained in that
time, so instead of bringing the preference back and resurrecting
it, remove it and shrink the memory usage of the diameter dissector.

Related to #16833, as it will make adding the command code value
string simpler.

notes.body:
Would that show up as one new issue and one fixed since the function name changed but none of the code did?

I will take a look.

`proto_item_fill_label` should always null terminate the string buffer passed into it, even if it's not null terminated originally (though if it is NULL or less than ITEM_LABEL_LENGTH in size there are issues), even if the field info passed into it is NULL, even if the hfinfo type is a type not handled by `proto_item_fill_label` (and it reports a dissector bug.) I don't see the issue immediately, but if there is one, seems like it would somehow be in there.
